speaker: elowen
text: To Emberhollow â and to whoever finally finishes Marga's pie!

speaker: elowen
text: Take it! Follow me down â I'll leave you a trail!

speaker: elowen
text: Rise, Knight of the Dawn.

speaker: elowen
text: Note 9: "I can see the vault. Something very large is sleeping under the floor. Malthrax keeps saying 'Gorvax'."

speaker: elowen
text: Note 4: "Malthrax says there are five seals and one breaks with every moonrise. Hurry. But eat something."

speaker: elowen
text: Note 7: "Ashforge. They chain smiths to the anvils. The chimera wears a collar â Brakk is afraid of it."

speaker: elowen
text: Note 2: "The spider-rider is called Skarn. He talks to his mount. It does not answer. Neither do I."

speaker: elowen
text: Note 5: "The crystals hum when the basilisk looks at them. Mirrors, perhaps? Bring something shiny."

speaker: elowen
text: Note 1: "If you are reading this, you followed. Good. They tied my hands but not my pencil. â E."

speaker: elowen
text: Note 10: "His staff is the anchor. Break it and I am free. I will be ready. â Your friend, E."

speaker: elowen
text: Note 3: "Water to my knees. Sister Vey sings to the old lizard. It is very bad singing."

speaker: elowen
text: Note 8: "Brakk carries a dwarf-made hammer far too fine for him. Brambur will know it."

speaker: elowen
text: Note 6: "Mushrooms that scream. I am not making this up. Kill the little ones first."

speaker: malthrax
text: Five moons, Emberhollow. Then you kneel before Blackspire.

speaker: malthrax
text: Princess. You will make a lovely key.

speaker: narrator
text: The tunnel widens into a nest of chewed bones, gnawed armour and stolen cutlery, piled into a lopsided throne. Something big stirs on top of it and sniffs the air.

speaker: narrator
text: Crystals here grow in a perfect ring around a pedestal of black glass. Your reflections in them stop moving when you do. Then one of them smiles.

speaker: narrator
text: The cave drops into a drowned amphitheatre, water black and mirror-still. Ripples spread from the centre, where nothing should be.

speaker: narrator
text: The forge-hall opens up around an anvil the size of a wagon, glowing white-hot. Heavy footsteps ring out from beyond the smoke.

speaker: narrator
text: The ground shakes. Bones of enormous beasts form an archway here, and the hot, rotten wind blowing through it is breath.

speaker: tamsin
text: When I was a girl, the Warden kept a horn that woke the whole valley. It's down in the vault still. Sound it when the big lizard wakes â trust an old woman.

speaker: rowan
text: You. You fought like the Dawn's own knight. Take this writ â it gives you the Crown's authority below. Bring her back. I'll have work for you in town, too.

speaker: osric
text: The princess carried a satchel of relics from this temple. If it survived, it fell in the Drowned Grotto. Bring it back and the Temple will owe you a life.

speaker: rowan
text: Four of my guards chased the cultists into the Rat-Warrens and never came back. Bring them home and I'll see you paid â and they'll fight at your side.

speaker: wren
text: Glowcaps! The Glimmerdeep is full of them. Three, and I can brew you something for basilisk trouble. Stone-to-flesh, dear. Very fashionable.

speaker: marga
text: Something's digging into my cellar from below. Scratching all night. Collapse that tunnel and you'll never pay for a room again.

speaker: dobbin
text: They took my brother smiths to the Ashforge in chains. Free them and I'll forge you the finest blade in Emberhollow.

speaker: marga
text: Quiet as a tomb down there now. Rooms are free for you, love. Forever. Don't tell the others.

speaker: dobbin
text: My brothers are home. This blade took all six of us to forge. +2, and it sings when it cuts.

speaker: wren
text: Perfect caps! Three Potions of Stone-to-Flesh. Drink one if you start feeling... gravelly.

speaker: rowan
text: One more thing, Knight. The Sovereign's staff... we never found it among the rubble.

speaker: osric
text: Her relics! The Temple owes you a life â one Raise Dead, free. And take these.

speaker: rowan
text: All four, alive! Here's 75 gold. They'll walk the Warrens with you from now on.

speaker: marga
text: Nobody finishes my pie. That's the tradition.

speaker: rowan
text: The town's behind you. Bring her home.

speaker: marga
text: Room's ready whenever you are.

speaker: tamsin
text: Blow it hard. Wake the valley.

speaker: osric
text: The Temple stands with you.

speaker: dobbin
text: The forges are lit for you.

speaker: wren
text: Mind the basilisk, dear.

speaker: narrator
text: Heat slaps your face. Slag crawls glowing through dwarf-cut channels, and hammers ring from forges that should be cold. Ash sifts down, bitter with sulphur, gritty between your teeth. Every shadow flickers, and some flicker back. Whatever feeds the Ashforge is still hungry.

speaker: narrator
text: Silence falls like a lid. Colossal pillars carved with roaring lizards rise into darkness above claw-scored floors. The air smells of warm scales and old blood, and trembles with slow, heavy breathing. Elowen's light lies somewhere beyond. So does the thing that guards it.

speaker: narrator
text: Wet steps lead down into low, dripping tunnels that reek of damp straw and old cheese. Tiny claws scritch in every crack. Your torch catches dozens of red eyes that blink out the moment you look. Somewhere ahead a soup-tin bell tinkles once: the Rat-Warrens are awake.

speaker: narrator
text: The Glimmerdeep opens like the inside of a geode, its crystals humming one endless note. A hundred reflections march beside you, each a heartbeat out of step. The air smells of flint and ozone. Deeper in stand statues frozen in surprise. Nobody carved them.

speaker: narrator
text: Cold water closes over your boots, and the splash rolls away through vaulted caves. Pale fungus glows above black pools far deeper than they look. The air tastes of salt and rust. Something large shifts beneath the Drowned Grotto, then goes still.

speaker: narrator
text: You raise the Warden's Warhorn and blow. The note rolls up through five floors of stone, and far above, Emberhollow's bells answer.

speaker: narrator
text: Back in Emberhollow, in the Boar & Spoon, which is still missing a few spoons, Elowen draws Dawnfang and lays it on your shoulder.

speaker: narrator
text: Then the candles gutter out, all at once. Robed figures pour through the cellar door, with rats and wolf-spiders at their heels.

speaker: narrator
text: Emberhollow, harvest night. The Boar & Spoon is packed to the rafters, and Princess Elowen herself is pouring the cider.

speaker: narrator
text: As the last cultist falls, the hearth fire turns violet. A tall shadow steps out of it, wearing a crown of black iron.

speaker: narrator
text: Shadow-hands seize Elowen. As she is dragged into the fire, she wrenches her signet ring free and throws it to you.

speaker: narrator
text: The fire goes out. Elowen is gone. The floor of the cellar has cracked open onto a stair leading down.

speaker: narrator
text: Gorvax the Tyrant crashes down, and the Blackspire shudders. One by one its violet lights go dark.

speaker: narrator
text: Far below, in the dark of the empty vault, a sixth seal nobody knew about begins to glow.

speaker: narrator
text: Emberhollow huddles in the long shadow of the Blackspire, a jumble of slate roofs and leaning chimneys. The square smells of woodsmoke and hot pies, and a bell tolls the hour a little nervously. Townsfolk hurry past, glancing at the dark tower the way you glance at a sleeping dog. Everyone here has lost someone to the maze.

speaker: narrator
text: Straw dummies hang from posts in the Training Grounds, most of them missing their heads. The air rings with clashing steel, barked orders and the thud of arrows striking targets. A grizzled sergeant watches you sideways and mutters something about soft hands.

speaker: narrator
text: Silence falls like a lid. Colossal pillars carved with roaring lizards rise into darkness above claw-scored floors. The air smells of warm scales and old blood, and trembles with slow, heavy breathing. Elowen\

speaker: narrator
text: The Temple of Cant is cool and hushed, lit by tall candles that never quite drip. Incense of cedar and myrrh drifts past a donation box the size of a coffin. Somewhere a priest is counting coins very quietly.

speaker: narrator
text: The cobbles end at a ring of standing stones around a gaping stair. Cold air breathes up from below, carrying faint echoes: a drip, a scratch, something like distant laughter. The town\

speaker: narrator
text: The Boar & Spoon is warm, loud and smells of spilled ale, roast onions and wet dog. A fiddler saws at something cheerful in the corner while a mounted boar\

speaker: narrator
text: Water pools in the middle of this chamber, and the walls are furred with nests of shredded cloth. The smell is magnificent, in the worst way.

speaker: narrator
text: A low chamber stacked with mouldy grain sacks, every one of them gnawed open. The floor crunches underfoot, and you decide not to look down.

speaker: narrator
text: Dozens of tiny shrines line this room: thimbles, buttons and bent spoons arranged with real devotion around a portrait of a very fat rat.

speaker: narrator
text: Carved pillars of roaring lizards hold up a ceiling lost in darkness. Rain-sound echoes from far above, though there is no sky.

speaker: narrator
text: Stalactites drip in this grotto like a broken water clock. The pools below are full of tiny white crabs that click in unison.

speaker: narrator
text: The concealed grotto is dark: no crystals, no reflections, no hum. The silence is the loudest thing you have heard all day.

speaker: narrator
text: Shipwreck timbers jut from the walls of this cave, though the sea is miles away. A barnacled figurehead watches you pass.

speaker: narrator
text: Huge amethyst columns split the light into slow purple rainbows. The floor is warm, and faintly ticks like cooling glass.

speaker: narrator
text: Cool water pours from the mouth of a stone dwarf into a quenching trough. Steam curls up, smelling of iron and relief.

speaker: narrator
text: A hidden smithy, its tools neatly hung and its coals banked as if the smith stepped out for lunch a hundred years ago.

speaker: narrator
text: The hidden passage is lined with tiny claw-marked tallies. Someone, or several someones, has been counting days here.

speaker: narrator
text: A garden of luminous mushrooms grows in a perfect spiral here. Stepping off the path makes them all turn to face you.

speaker: narrator
text: A chamber of cooling moulds, each one shaped like a different weapon. Several of the moulds are empty and still warm.

speaker: narrator
text: Here the rat-sign stops, as if even the vermin give this spot a wide berth. Something waits here that is not a rat.

speaker: narrator
text: The hum of the crystals drops to a low, almost-words murmur here, as if the cavern is trying to tell you something.

speaker: narrator
text: Shards of a shattered geode the size of a cottage litter this chamber, still humming with whatever broke out of it.

speaker: narrator
text: A spring of warm, glowing water rises here, fizzing gently. The fungus around it grows in the shape of open hands.

speaker: narrator
text: Here the hammer-song stops. Tools lie where they were dropped, mid-swing, and the air smells of a hasty departure.

speaker: narrator
text: A spiral stair corkscrews down into the dark. A cold draught rises from it, carrying the smell of standing water.

speaker: narrator
text: Behind the false wall is a dry pocket of air that smells of old parchment. Someone hid here while the water rose.

speaker: narrator
text: A pool of liquid starlight shimmers in a crystal bowl. Drinking it tastes like the first cold breath of winter.

speaker: narrator
text: A basin of violet light pulses slowly, like a resting heartbeat. The pain of the road drains away as you drink.

speaker: narrator
text: Eggshells as big as barrels lie cracked open across this chamber. Whatever hatched has had a long time to grow.

speaker: narrator
text: A flooded hall where bioluminescent eels drift between broken columns, lighting the water in slow blue pulses.

speaker: narrator
text: A brass-railed stair plunges into dark heat. Each step down is a little warmer, and the walls start to sweat.

speaker: narrator
text: Racks of half-finished armour line the walls here, helmets turned so that every empty visor watches the door.

speaker: narrator
text: Old murals here show tiny heroes fleeing a towering lizard. The last panel has been scratched out with claws.

speaker: narrator
text: This hidden alcove holds the bones of a knight in mirrored armour, one hand still pointing toward the vault.

speaker: narrator
text: Bellows the size of houses wheeze in this hall, pushed by nothing you can see. Embers dance in the draught.

speaker: narrator
text: An ore-cart track loops through this cavern, and a cart full of glowing slag still creaks slowly along it.

speaker: narrator
text: Steps slick with algae lead down past a waterline carved with the warning "HIGH TIDE". The ink is fresh.

speaker: narrator
text: Clear water bubbles from a cracked basin carved with a smiling face. It smells, astonishingly, of mint.

speaker: narrator
text: A crystal stair spirals downward, each step chiming a note as you test it. The tune is not a happy one.

speaker: narrator
text: A trophy hall of crushed shields and bent swords, each tagged with a name in neat, patient handwriting.

speaker: narrator
text: A gallery of statues frozen mid-stride, each one carrying a mirror that was raised a moment too late.

speaker: narrator
text: The floor here is scorched in a long, perfect line, as if lightning once ran along it on four legs.

speaker: narrator
text: A ring of half-sunken lanterns marks this place, each one still somehow burning beneath the water.

speaker: narrator
text: Nets heavy with old catches hang from the ceiling here. Some of the catches are wearing boots.

speaker: vexrath
text: Application approved. Vexrath Quillscale, paladin, reporting. Please initial here, here and here.

speaker: grumsh
text: Very well. I shall follow you into the dark. It is where I keep my feelings anyway.

speaker: vexrath
text: Encounter closed. Outcome: favourable. Please rate your smiting experience.

speaker: grumsh
text: Let me play you to sleep. It is a lament. They are all laments.

speaker: vexrath
text: Rest period approved: eight hours, minus one hour of filing.

speaker: grumsh
text: Another battle. Another verse for my endless ballad of woe.

speaker: vexrath
text: I have filed my joining papers in triplicate. Let us begin.

speaker: vexrath
text: Have you filed a permit to attack us? No? Most irregular.

speaker: grumsh
text: Grumsh joins. Grumsh has packed his lute and his sorrow.

speaker: vexrath
text: Hostile encounter logged. Form 7-B: Smiting, commencing.

speaker: grumsh
text: Victory. I shall compose something unbearably moving.

speaker: grumsh
text: Ah. Violence. The only song I was ever good at.

speaker: grumsh
text: I will keep watch. Sleep is for the untroubled.

speaker: vexrath
text: Promotion granted! I shall need a bigger stamp.

speaker: vexrath
text: I will catch up on my backlog of blessings.

speaker: grumsh
text: I grow stronger. My sorrow grows with me.

text: m terribly sorry about what
